rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: BATmercury
Exhibition name: Freddie Mercury
rows.Origin:
Discovered by Eric Stainthorpe (United Kingdom, 1994).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Battersby Roses in 1994 as 'Freddy Mercury'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow. Moderate fragrance. Medium, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Medium, bushy, few or no prickles/thorns. Glossy, dark green foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden.
